title: On the Opportunities and Challenges of Prefill-to-Autoregressive Cross-Model Transfer
abstract: arXiv:2611.06976v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Prefill-to-Autoregressive Cross-model Transfer (PACT), a form of latent communication between language models, combines a larger model's prompt representations with a smaller model's efficient generation, offering a promising way to balance capability and inference cost. However, existing systems provide limited support for independently evaluating large-small model collaboration, and improved task performance alone does not establish whether the receiver benefits from the sender's information. We introduce PLatour, an open-source PACT framework that connects frozen models through lightweight, zero-initialized linear bridges trained directly with task rewards and supports hybrid-attention architectures. PLatour significantly outperforms open-source baselines on generation tasks and surpasses Mostik's reported results on shared mathematics and coding benchmarks using a substantially smaller sender. translated_title: 论预填充到自回归跨模型迁移的机遇与挑战
translated_abstract: 预填充到自回归跨模型迁移，是语言模型之间潜在通信的一种形式，它将较大模型的提示表示与较小模型的高效生成相结合，为平衡能力与推理成本提供了一种有前景的途径。然而，现有系统对独立评估大小模型协作的支持有限，且仅凭任务性能的提升并不能证明接收方是否真正受益于发送方的信息。我们提出了PLatour，一个开源的PACT框架，它通过轻量级、零初始化的线性桥接来连接冻结的模型，这些桥接直接使用任务奖励进行训练，并支持混合注意力架构。PLatour在生成任务上显著优于开源基线，并在共享的数学与编码基准上使用规模小得多的发送方超越了Mostik报告的结果。然而，受控实验表明……
tldr: 本文提出开源PACT框架PLatour，通过零初始化线性桥接连接冻结的大小模型实现潜在通信，在生成任务上显著超越基线，同时揭示了独立评估跨模型信息迁移有效性的挑战。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces PLatour, an open-source PACT framework connecting frozen models via lightweight zero-initialized linear bridges trained with task rewards, which significantly outperforms baselines on generation tasks while revealing the challenges of independently evaluating cross-model information transfer.
